title: Five Stars
text: Five Stars. this is an update of my previous review. I bought this bed it was comfortable. After a few months it developed a bulge in the middle. I was sent a replacement and after a few months the same thing happened. Now I'm being told that it won't get replaced because it's past the date of purchase. It's not been a year since being replaced though. It should be warrantied from the date of replacement. You'll be better off buying a real bed. If this is the #1 rated air mattress, it's not worth the rating or hassle.
